# PR #3959: Patch: a dungeon fight has a Menu button that asks before it leaves, so Concede is no longer the only way off its board

Closes #3932

### What changed and why

In a dungeon fight, `<Game>` was passed no `controlExtras` or `boardRail`, and the app shell hides navigation while a board is active. Conceding was the only button off the board, but conceding a dungeon fight ends the entire run for good.

This patch adds a Menu button to `<Game>`'s `controlExtras` in [`FightScreen.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3932/apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx) following the practice convention (`className="control control-practice-menu"`, label "Menu", accessible name and title "Main menu", testid `fightTestid.menu`), which calls `navigate(paths.play)`:
- **Mid-fight**: Navigation is held by the existing leave guard (`guardLeaving`). The button carries `aria-haspopup="dialog"`. Clicking it opens the existing "Leave this fight?" alert dialog (`fightTestid.leaveDialog`) with "Keep playing" focused. Staying dismisses the dialog and keeps playing; confirming ("Leave fight") navigates to the Play menu (`paths.play`), where the run can resume mid-fight later where it stood.
- **After the fight concludes**: Once the fight reaches a result (`state.phase === "over"`), the leave guard is released and the button has no `aria-haspopup`. Clicking Menu navigates directly to `paths.play` without asking.
- **Concede and Continue**: Concede and its run-ending dialog remain unchanged; Continue continues to submit the fight report to the run.

## What it actually means

In a dungeon fight the board has no Menu or Back button, and the app hides its own menus while a board is up. A player who wants to step away mid-fight (to look at their collection, say, or because they opened the game from their phone's home screen, where there is no browser Back button) has only Concede, and conceding a dungeon fight ends the whole run for good. Once this is built, the fight's controls get a Menu button, as a practice game's do. Pressing it mid-fight asks “Leave this fight?” and says the fight waits where it stood. Leaving goes to the Play menu, and the run picks the fight up again when they come back.

## Why

- `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:291-329`: the fight's `<Game>` is given `matchStatus`, `heroAside`, `resultActions` and `concedeBody`, and no `controlExtras` or `boardRail`, so no control on the board navigates anywhere.

- Every other table has a way off. Practice passes New game and Menu as `controlExtras` (`apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx:1064-1087,1120`), each asking first mid-game. - Pass the fight's `<Game>` a `controlExtras` Menu button, labelled as practice's is (Menu, with Main menu as its accessible name), that calls `navigate(paths.play)`.
